featurelessRelease.scope: Direct Rust executable, PATH=/nonexistent, env cleared; real doctor/list/export/parser/help, source controls, file publication, SIGTERM and broken pipe/recovery. Helper is metadata-only doctor fixture, never executed. No Bun/Node engine sidecar. No install or real OS Vault.

largeHistoryExport.sourceRecords: Ten 100MiB tool strings skipped plus three 10MiB assistant strings; no sparse/invalid padding. All source/output hashes checked after each trial.
largeHistoryExport.measurement: Owned single CLI PID, sampled macOS RSS about every 50ms via ps. No footprint/live allocation/process-tree/interactive/4h acceptance. First trial overlapped a short owned fixture-mode comparison; remaining trials ran alone. Times are observations, not latency acceptance.

behaviors: Index-only list handles all three roles, preserves original title/time order and empty stderr notice; corrupt/duplicate/unsafe index fails without body/sidecar read or migration.

Doctor inspects actual current executable, same-directory executable Helper, writable root/nearest existing parent, version and optional terminal facts. No mkdir, Helper execution, credential read, network or repair. Mandatory failures exit1.

Display reader distinguishes provisional visible stream text from canonical committed model history, validates skipped UTF8/JSON/depth, bounds selected fields and captured scan horizon, and fails on changed source or orphan/future/invalid patch.

Redacted Markdown uses actual TS shapes/patterns, includes redacted header metadata, excludes raw tools/Evidence, rejects unsafe terminal/bidi text on stdout and permits an explicit file reading copy. Patterns do not detect every opaque secret.

Anonymous 0600 spool precedes publication. No-clobber or force target CAS with bounded cancelable OS parent-directory lock and atomic rename, rejects Store/source aliases/nonregular paths. Cooperative file identities are not an OS path sandbox.
Pre-publication cancellation, invalid source, lost target generation and lock wait preserve the old target and clean owned temporary files; later explicit export succeeds.

After rename, directory sync or successful-receipt pipe failure reports publication unknown and retains committed bytes. Fresh explicit force captures the current generation; default retry refuses clobber.
Full stdout backpressure is cancelable via real SIGTERM, returns4 with a partial copy; closed reader fails1 and later export succeeds. No task, grant, history or unknown mutation.
